text:
Many asked me how to make these, so I turned it into a skill~

Colorfigures: Describe an everyday object, and Claude draws it hand-inked and isometric, with buttons that actually work.

You can also ask how something works and the skill will label the parts to explain how each part does its job.

Free and open source 👇
